tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.outfit.a: Road dust, a red bandana and a mana revolver in the holster.
Grey duster, silver conchos and cartridges glowing blue: the bounty always gets paid.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.outfit.m: Crimson coat, white hat and a golden star: the fastest law in the arcane west.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.outfit.a: Black and gold, an ember serape and singing spurs: when the bell tolls, the duel is already over.
gun.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.revolver.des: Six mana chambers: a strong, accurate shot. The kit revolver grows in grades (I–IV) at the Guild and Trials.
gun.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.pistol.desc: Automatic: hold the button. 12 rounds, high fire rate, lower damage per bullet.
gun.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.shotgun.desc: Sawed-off double barrel: 7 pellets per shot and a kick that pushes you back. Point-blank perfection. 2 rounds.
gun.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.dual_pistols: One in each hand (the second appears in your empty hand), firing in turns. 16 rounds, blistering fire rate.
gun.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.rifle.desc: Lever-action rifle with a scope (sneak to aim). The bullet pierces 1 target; huge damage. 5 rounds.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_bullet.desc: Gunslinger weapon form: a very fast mana bullet (~96 block range) carries the spell's effects. Split = bullets side by side. With a loaded mana gun in hand it spends 1 round and hits 10% harder (+5% per revolver grade). Headshot: ×1.5 (Gunslinger) or ×1.25.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_burst.desc: Weapon form: three shots in a row (+1 per Split), one every 3 ticks, following your aim. Each shot is a copy and pays for the effects (per-copy cost).
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_charged_shot.desc: Weapon form: hold your aim for 1 s and release a heavy bullet with a sonic boom — ×1.8 power, pierces 1 target and knocks back.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_ricochet.desc: Weapon form: the bullet bounces from enemy to enemy (2 bounces + Ricochet, seeks up to 14 blocks) applying the spell to each one. Every bounce counts as a copy in the cost.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_piercing.desc: Weapon form: an INSTANT straight shot up to 64 blocks (×Accelerate) that passes through up to 5 enemies (+Pierce) and stops at the first solid block. Headshots count.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_high_noon.desc: Gunslinger G form (ultimate): the noon bell tolls three times — enemies in front of you (up to 32 blocks, ×Expand) are marked and slowed; on the last toll you draw and hit them all at once: every shot is a headshot with ×2 power. 6 targets (+2 per Split, max 14). Circle 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_incendiary.desc: Gunslinger Fire effect: fire damage (base 4.5), sets the target ablaze and stacks Burning for 4 s (×Extend). On blocks it only sparks (no fire).
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_explosive.desc: Effect: the bullet bursts in a 2.5 block radius (×Expand) — damage to every enemy (base 5) and a shove. Never breaks blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_mark.desc: Effect: a light shot (base 1.5) that marks the target for 6 s (×Extend) — it glows, becomes Exposed and YOUR bullets hit it as sure shots (×1.35, stacks with headshots).
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_fan_hammer.desc: Weapon form augment: every shot becomes a fan of 1 + 2 bullets per level, one every 2 ticks (the off hand slaps the hammer). Each fanned bullet is a copy and pays for the effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gun_on_reload.desc: Trigger (at the start of the recipe): whenever you reload a mana gun, this slot's spell casts itself (pays Focus and respects its cooldown). The slot key does not cast it.
legend.isekai_mahou.preachers_cross.desc: A tribute to a wandering preacher's machine-gun cross: a double burst of explosive, incendiary bullets sweeping the Gunslinger's front. (Trigger Path rank III.)
legend.isekai_mahou.silver_jackal.desc: A tribute to an immortal monster hunter's giant pistol: a twice-amplified piercing round that marks and blows up everything in its line. (Trigger Path rank V.)
path.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.need_class: Only a Gunslinger walks the Trigger Path
path.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.req.duel: Beat the Spectral Outlaw at high noon
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.title: Trigger Path
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.subtitle: Five ranks of gunpowder and mana
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.materiali: Creates the gun with 25%% of your max Focus (once every 30 s). One of each kind in your inventory.
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.bonus.des:
• Reload 40%% faster for half the Focus
• Headshots ×1.5 (other classes ×1.25)
• Weapon forms refund 20%% Focus and cool down 25%% faster
• +4%% bullet damage per rank
• Full outfit: reload another 15%% faster
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_tip1: Between 10:00 and 14:00 in-game, under open sky: the Spectral Outlaw appears 14 blocks away. Wait for the bell and DRAW! — shooting early is a foul.
screen.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_tip2: At noon: the High Noon Reaper — more health, a faster draw, dodges and fanning. Reload when he reloads.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.gun.rank: Grows stronger with every Trigger Path rank
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.gun.relo: Full reload: %s%% of max Focus (half for a Gunslinger)
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.gun.spel: In hand: weapon forms (Bullet, Burst...) spend 1 round and hit harder. Reload with the swap-hands key.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.material: Your mana is still settling: wait %s s.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.locked: Gun unlocked at Trigger Path rank %s.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.noon_emp: No enemy in sight for the Twelve Tolls.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.reload_o: This spell has the On Reload trigger: it fires by itself when you reload.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.not_read: You can't claim this rank yet:
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.ready: Trigger Path rank %s (%s) is ready to claim! Menu (B) → Trigger Path.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.weapon_u: New mana gun: %s! (Materialize more from the B menu.)
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.outfit.e: The new outfit was equipped (old pieces went to your inventory).
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.outfit.i: The new pieces went to your inventory (you were wearing others).
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_sta: The Spectral Outlaw accepts the challenge. At high noon, one of you falls.
The High Noon Reaper rises from the dust. He never misses twice.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_rul: Rules: wait for the bell and the DRAW! sign — shooting or casting before it is a foul. Hitting right after the signal = Perfect Draw (×2 damage).
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_act: You are already in a duel.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_noo: Duels only at HIGH NOON (10:00–14:00 in-game), under open sky in the Overworld.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_spa: No room for a duel: find open, flat ground.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_not: No duel pending on the Trigger Path right now.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_fou: Foul! You drew before the signal — the outlaw vanishes, disappointed. Try again later.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_win: Duel won! The legend of the trigger grows.
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel_los: The duel is over: you left the field (or fell). The outlaw tips his hat and vanishes.
The sun has passed noon... the outlaw fades into the wind. Duel lost.
title.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.duel.sub: Hand off the trigger until the signal...
title.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.win.sub: The Spectral Outlaw tips his hat to you
title.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.win.sub2: The High Noon Reaper bites the dust
command.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.rank: Trigger Path granted up to rank %s.
command.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.no_gun: Hold a mana gun in your main hand.
glyph.isekai_mahou.photon_sword.desc: Origin form (homage to the Gun Gale swordsman's light blade): the energy blade slashes in an arc in front of you (4 blocks ×Expand, 140°) — effects at ×1.25 — and CUTS bullets, arrows and spells in its path, deflecting them back at the shooter; for 0.4 s after each slash, whatever comes at you is deflected. Split = extra slashes (up to 4). Unlock: Trigger Path rank III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bullet_line.desc: Origin form (prediction): for 10 s (×Extend) you see RED LINES from whoever aims at you and from projectiles heading your way (only you see them) and gain 3 dodges (+1 per Split, up to 6) — the predicted hit misses and you sidestep. With effects in the spell, each dodge fires a counter-shot (80%). Works with no effect. Unlock: rank II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.aim_circle.desc: Origin form (precision shot): the green circle appears on your sight (only you see it) and CLOSES while you stand still (sneaking closes faster); moving widens it and your heartbeat makes it pulse. Once closed (≈1.2 s) the shot fires on its own as a CRITICAL (×2.5, counts as a headshot). If it doesn't close in 2 s, it fires as it is — weaker and off-target. Instant shot, 128 blocks. Unlock: rank I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.optical_camo.desc: Origin form (homage to the skull sniper's cloak): the cloak switches on and you vanish — Invisible for 8 s (×Extend), creatures lose sight of you and won't pick you as a target (only point-blank, 3 blocks). Your FIRST attack is an AMBUSH (×1.5) and turns the cloak off. Works with no effect; beneficial effects go on you. Unlock: rank IV.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_star.desc: Origin form (homage to the skull sniper's pistol): you make the sign of the cross and fire the black bullet — instant, 96 blocks, ×1.6 (headshots count). EXECUTION: a common creature left at 30% health or less falls at once. Players and bosses are never executed: they get Exposed III and Wither. Out of Optical Camouflage the shot is silent and the ambush stacks. Unlock: rank IV + 10 camouflaged ambushes.
glyph.isekai_mahou.anti_materiel.desc: Origin form (homage to the ice sniper and her giant rifle): aim for 1.2 s and fire an instant shot up to 192 blocks (×Accelerate) that passes through 3 targets (+Pierce) and breaks defenses (Exposed II). SNEAKING (on the bipod): ×2.4, no spread. Standing: ×1.4, spread and the recoil throws you back. Unlock: rank IV.
glyph.isekai_mahou.stellar_burst.desc: G form (homage to the black swordsman's 16-hit combo): locks onto the enemy in front of you (10 blocks) and unleashes 16 hits in 1.6 s, ALTERNATING photon slashes and gunshots, circling around it every 4 hits. Each hit applies the effects (65%); the 16th hits ×2. If the target falls, it jumps to the next. Resistance IV during the combo. Circle 8. Unlock: rank V + 150 photon hits.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spirit_gun.desc: Origin form (homage to the spirit detective's finger shot): no gun needed — you focus your spirit on your fingertip (0.7 s) and fire a blue orb that passes through 1 target and EXPLODES (radius 2.5, ×Expand). More Focus = stronger (×1.3 empty up to ×2.0 full); spends another 10% of your current Focus. Unlock: rank II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.two_hands.desc: Origin form (homage to the two-pistol gunwoman): you spin and shoot in EVERY direction — 12 shots (+4 per Split, up to 24) in 1.2 s, one from each hand; each shot seeks the nearest enemy in its sector. Each bullet is a copy (55% power). Unlock: rank III.
legend.isekai_mahou.gunslinger_starburst: The G form with critical and amplified arcane damage: sixteen strikes of light and lead.
legend.isekai_mahou.gunslinger_black_sta: The black bullet marks the target and hits it with amplified arcane damage — and executes whoever is left weak.
legend.isekai_mahou.gunslinger_moon_godd: Shot of the Frozen Moon Goddess
The anti-materiel rifle pierces the line, freezing and blowing up every target.
callout.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.bullet_l: You see the shots before they come · %s dodges
callout.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.optical_: The cloak is on: no one sees you
callout.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.black_st: The sign of the cross... and the black bullet
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.aim_part: The circle didn't close (%s%%): shot off-target
message.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.burst_em: No enemy in front for the Stellar Burst.
